title: HS30104: Law And Economics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneIntroduction to Law and Economics: Overview of the common
law system, Efficiency versus Distribution; Regulation and Public Choice;
Coarse Theorem: The problem of social cost; Economic Theories of Property Law,
Contract Law, Corporate Law; Competition Law, Tort and Insurance Law, Tax Law,
Environmental Law, Trade Law, Labour Law, Crime and Punishment, and Family Law.
